scope: Short synthetic native-state upgrade and portable rollback; not full-data release acceptance
previousIdentity: Verify the installed platform receipt and actual executable SHA-256 before launching; retain both binary identities
text: Synthetic Unicode only; no consumer records
sequence: Build a separate portable synthetic seed
Import seed into native disk/WAL state with the previous released engine
Acknowledge document, Auth and Storage writes; observe both browser targets in both modes
Cleanly stop previous engine and reopen the same native directory with the candidate, without import
Verify all three service states and browser reconnect/update delivery
Complete candidate portable export and stop
Import that completed export into a different native directory with the previous released engine and verify all three services
criteria: Every assertion must pass; zero browser errors or listener errors; original seed, upgraded working state and rollback state remain separate
limits: Does not promise native downgrade across changed formats, compatibility with unpublished historical binaries, crash or low-disk safety. Those require independent existing or new fault evidence. Portable rollback imports into a new directory and never overwrites the upgraded working state.
